title: Resume validation regenerates prompts without agent and model context
reasoning: Execution supplies agent_type, agent_version, and model_name to prompt rendering, but resume validation supplies only is_continuation. An unchanged template using these supported fields consequently renders differently during resume, invalidating completed checkpoints and every subsequent checkpoint unnecessarily.
reproduction: Save a prompt through get_task_for_checkpoint using a template containing model_name and a nonempty model name. Validate the same checkpoint and template through detect_resume_point with prompt validation enabled; the expected prompt lacks the model context and mismatches.
recommendation: Share prompt context construction between execution and resume, and pass the same agent and model metadata through the resume validation API.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied resume tests cover artifact presence, errors, and usage aggregation but do not compare execution-generated prompts against resume rendering with agent or model metadata.
suggestedRegressionTest: Round-trip execution-generated prompts through resume validation for all supported context fields and continuation states; unchanged inputs must remain valid, while changed rendered inputs must invalidate dependent checkpoints.
minimumFixScope: Resume prompt-generation parameters and shared context construction with get_task_for_checkpoint.

history.reasoning: The original paths and symbols still exist, but their code now supports the repair: runner.py:207 and resume.py:91 share build_prompt_context; resume.py:170-173 forwards agent and model metadata. Both resume detection branches and CLI/worker callers propagate that metadata. tests/agent_runner/resume_test.py:705 covers execution/resume equivalence for initial and continuation prompts, plus dependent invalidation after a model change. No linked patch attempts were supplied. However, targeted pytest validation exited 1 before collection because the read-only environment provided no usable temporary directory. The repair appears implemented, but failed validation prevents a fixed verdict.
